route: explicit code labels (S6 coding manual) + 9 (S5 vs live counts) + 3 (published totals/alpha) + 6 (polarity)
evidence: Routes: explicit code labels + 9 (response-frequency matching) + 3 (published totals/alpha) + 6 (per-item polarity). LABEL TIE: study S6 SPSS coding manual labels column Qk 'NEP Scale Question k' for k=1..15, and S1 File numbers the 15 statements 1..15 -- a label match for every item. ROUTE 9 (live vs S5 File .xlsx): per-item resp 1..5 count vectors match 15/15 on the diagonal, 0 exact off-diagonal hits, min off-diagonal L1 distance 8, so every live item is distinguished from every other (e.g. Q1 2/15/30/44/15, Q6 19/59/15/12/1, Q9 0/0/5/67/34, Q14 1/25/30/44/6, identical live). OPTION AXIS (route 3): live sum(Q1..Q15) == S5 NEP_Tot for 106/106 persons; stored values reproduce published total mean/SD/alpha exactly -- combined 54.40/6.57/0.787 (pub 54.4/6.57/0.787), Australia 54.58/6.91/0.815 (pub 54.58/6.91/0.815), UK 54.10/6.04/0.734 (pub 54.10/6.04/0.734) -- while re-reversing the seven even items gives 49.91/3.80/0.223, so even items are stored scored (SA=1..SD=5) and odd items SA=5..SD=1, as option_text maps them. ROUTE 6: flipping any single stored item lowers combined alpha (range 0.66-0.78 vs 0.787), pinning every item's stored direction as pro-ecological-high. Corroboration (route 8): Q6 'plenty of natural resources' is the least pro-NEP item (mean 2.22) and Q7 'plants and animals ... right' / Q9 'subject to the laws of nature' the most (4.42/4.27), the usual NEP pattern. WHAT THE STATISTICS DO NOT THEMSELVES ESTABLISH: that SPSS column Qk recorded statement k -- that tie is the study's coding-manual label match, a source-level label rather than an inference; the statistics pin the S5<->live identity of all 15 items and each item's polarity, not wording order within a polarity class.
